content: Melvin-Koushki concludes that the seventh level of the R. Shaqq-i Qamar should be understood as referring both to the Imams and to ancient prophets such as Hermes Trismegistus, as well as to 'those who can riddle their cryptic utterances'.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
